passages.title: Dialogue 1: Weekend Trip
passages.text: Woman: Are we still going to the coast on Saturday? Man: I'm afraid not. My brother is visiting, so we're going to have a big family lunch at home instead. Woman: Oh, that sounds nice anyway.

passages.title: Dialogue 2: Birthday Party
passages.text: Boy: Have you finished the invitations for your sister's party? Girl: Almost. I just need to add the time. My mum said we should start at four, but I think five is better so everyone can get there after work.

passages.title: Dialogue 3: School Project
passages.text: Man: Did you manage to help your cousin with his history project? Woman: Yes, we spent all evening looking at old family photos. It was actually quite interesting to see how much the house has changed.

passages.title: Dialogue 4: Moving House
passages.text: Woman: Are you ready for the move next week? Man: Not really. My uncle is coming to help us pack the boxes, but there is just so much stuff to sort through before then.

passages.title: Dialogue 5: Cinema Visit
passages.text: Boy: Shall we go to the cinema on Sunday? Girl: I can't. My aunt is taking the whole family to the theatre to see that new musical. Maybe we can go next week?

passages.title: Dialogue 6: Camping Trip
passages.text: Man: Is your family still planning to go camping in July? Woman: We were, but my grandmother is not feeling very well, so we've decided to stay at home and visit her instead.

questions.question: Why has the man changed his weekend plans?
questions.explanation: The man mentions his brother is visiting, which changes his plans to go to the coast.
options: a) A relative is coming to visit.
b) The weather is going to be bad.

questions.question: What is the girl doing regarding the party?
questions.explanation: She is deciding on the start time for the invitations.

questions.question: What did the woman do with her cousin?
questions.explanation: They looked at old family photos for a history project.

questions.question: How does the man feel about moving?
questions.explanation: He feels overwhelmed because there is a lot of work to do.
options: c) Stressed by the amount of work.

questions.question: What will the girl do on Sunday?
questions.explanation: She is going to the theatre with her family.

questions.question: Why is the family not going camping?
questions.explanation: The grandmother is ill, so they are staying home to visit her.
options: c) A family member is unwell.
